summary.zh: 关联计划订单、生产订单、工序和工作中心产能，识别负荷冲突并提出受约束的排程建议。
summary.en: Links planned orders, production operations and work-center capacity to identify overloads and recommend constrained schedules.

zh: 工厂与排程期间
工作中心或产能类别
计划订单和生产订单
优先级、换线和班次约束
en: Plant and scheduling horizon
Work center or capacity category
Planned and production orders
Priority, changeover and shift constraints

zh: 工作中心负荷与瓶颈
订单冲突
候选排程方案
影响与人工审批清单
en: Work-center load and bottlenecks
Order conflicts
Candidate schedules
Impact and human approval list

zh: 默认不调度或修改订单
仅在产能需求与可用产能单位一致时比较
空产能记录不得解释为无限产能
冻结区和已下达订单必须保留
en: Do not dispatch or change orders by default
Compare capacity only with compatible units
Never interpret missing capacity rows as unlimited capacity
Preserve frozen horizons and released orders

description.zh: 解析工厂、期间、工作中心、订单集合和业务约束。
description.en: Parse plant, horizon, work centers, order set and business constraints.

zh: 识别冻结区、优先订单和不可移动工序。
统一日期、时区、产能单位和班次日历。
en: Identify frozen horizons, priority orders and immovable operations.
Normalize dates, time zone, capacity unit and shift calendar.

description.zh: 验证计划订单、生产订单和工作中心服务的只读能力。
description.en: Validate read-only planned-order, production-order and work-center services.

zh: 检查 Thin Runtime 健康和服务可执行性。
验证计划订单产能、工作中心和订单工序字段。
en: Check Thin Runtime health and service executability.
Validate planned-order capacity, work-center and order-operation fields.

description.zh: 读取计划订单、生产订单工序、日期、数量和工作中心。
description.en: Read planned orders and production operations with dates, quantities and work centers.

zh: 按工厂和期间读取计划订单，保存固定和可转换标志。
按订单键读取工序，避免全工厂宽查询。
en: Read planned orders by plant and horizon and retain firm/convertible flags.
Read operations by order key rather than broad plant scans.

purpose.zh: 提供计划订单及产能需求。
purpose.en: Provides planned orders and capacity requirements.

description.zh: 读取工作中心、产能分配、班次和负荷桶。
description.en: Read work centers, capacity assignments, shifts and load buckets.

zh: 先按工厂和工作中心读取主数据及有效期。
只有参数化产能桶完整返回时才计算利用率。
en: Read master data and validity by plant and work center first.
Calculate utilization only when parameterized capacity buckets are complete.

purpose.zh: 提供工作中心和产能证据。

title.zh: 核对计划与工作中心表

description.zh: 通过 SAPSkillhub 读取 PLAF、CRHD、KAKO/KBED 证据。
description.en: Use SAPSkillhub to read PLAF, CRHD and KAKO/KBED evidence.

zh: 低行数验证订单和工作中心键。
发现导出超时或缺少选择条件时标记证据限制。
en: Validate order and work-center keys with low row counts.
Record evidence limits when export times out or lacks filters.

description.zh: 在明确约束下生成候选方案和影响分析。
description.en: Generate candidate schedules and impact analysis under explicit constraints.

zh: 比较延迟、换线、加班和在制品影响。
输出候选方案、不可满足约束和审批项，不自动派工。
en: Compare lateness, changeovers, overtime and WIP impact.
Present candidates, infeasible constraints and approvals without dispatching.
